items.title: Elvis Presley Rightsholders Sue Anthropic for Training on 274 Songs Without Permission
items.excerpt: The owners of Elvis Presley's music have sued AI company Anthropic, accusing it of training its models on 274 Presley songs without permission. A new filing, not covered in earlier briefs.

items.title: Anthropic Sued For Stealing Elvis Presley Music to Train AI: 'Deeply Protective of These Iconic Songs'
items.excerpt: Billboard's report on the same Elvis Presley rightsholders' suit against Anthropic over using his songs to train models. Duplicate story of the Rolling Stone item, keep one.

items.title: Spotify Co-CEOs Talk AI Remixing Tool: 'We're the Right Company to Do This'
items.excerpt: Spotify's co-CEOs discussed the coming AI music remixing tool for subscribers, saying it will generate new revenue for the industry. Overlaps the covered Spotify AI plan and remix-licensing stories.

items.title: AI-Generated Music and the Future of Creativity Discussed at Billboard Latin Music Week
items.excerpt: A Billboard Latin Music Week panel with Cristina Perpiñá-Robert and Pierre Hachar Jr. on AI in music and protecting human creators.

items.title: Is The Humanity of Instruments Under Threat from AI?
items.excerpt: The surge in vibe-coded instrument plugins has been overwhelming; Gearnews asks whether instrument design risks losing its most important feature, humanity.

history_match.title: Who's Buying All These Vibe-Coded Plugins?

items.title: Fender Studio Pro 8.2 Update: New Mixing and Workflow Features
items.excerpt: Studio Pro 8.2 adds Trim Automation, Dim Solo Mode and multiple marker tracks, expands its Stem Separation features and gives the Vocal Tune plugin a low-latency mode for live use. AI angle is incremental (stem separation).

items.title: New studies explore AI expectations, jobs impact and gender gap
items.excerpt: Several recent studies offer new views on how AI will affect jobs, expectations and the gender gap, beyond the AI-music debates gripping the industry.

items.title: Stop sending me vibecoded plugins, I'm begging you
items.excerpt: MusicTech's inbox is drowning in vibecoded AI plugins; the piece explains why that is a problem and which indie developers are doing it properly. Same theme as the covered Attack/BPB vibe-coding pieces.

items.title: Making a track with DEATHPIXIE and Suno | In The Cut
items.excerpt: Suno visits Glenwood Studios in Los Angeles for the Death Pixie writing camp, showing how a team builds tracks for a virtual rapper character using Suno.

history_match.title: How Seoul Institute of the Arts Students Use Suno | In The Cut

items.title: Meet Death Pixie
items.excerpt: Suno introduces Death Pixie, a rapper from a fictional crime-ridden city called New Tokyo, and the team bringing the character to life. Companion to the In The Cut episode.

items.title: Suno v. MLC Subpoena Dispute Boils Over as AI Platform Demands Multiple Years of DSP-Specific Streaming Data
items.excerpt: After months of back and forth, a subpoena dispute has boiled over between Suno and the Mechanical Licensing Collective, with Suno demanding years of DSP-specific streaming data. Procedural legal item.

history_match.title: Sony and Universal ask court to force Suno investor Lightspeed to testify about the 'legal risk of training data'

items.title: ICMP Says Australian Songs Used to Train AI Sans Compensation
items.excerpt: The ICMP told Australian legislators that hits by Kylie Minogue and Nick Cave were already used to train AI without compensation, warning that weakening copyright law would be 'legitimizing larceny.'

history_match.title: ARIA boss warns Australian politicians on AI lobbying demands

items.title: MuLaCover: Flexible Cover Song Generation via Symbolic Tonal Control
items.excerpt: A cover-song generation method for pretrained music language models: it explicitly controls tonal content (melody and chords) while reshaping other musical attributes such as style and instrumentation.

items.title: MQAScore: Fine-Grained Text-Music Alignment Evaluation via Large Audio Language Model
items.excerpt: Instead of one global text-audio similarity score, MQAScore uses a large audio language model to check each atomic musical concept in a prompt, showing which attributes a text-to-music output is missing.

items.title: Sori: Streamable and Controllable Model for Non-musical Audio to Symbolic Music Transformation
items.excerpt: Introduces a new task that converts non-musical audio (everyday sounds) into symbolic music; Sori is a streamable, controllable model for this one-to-many transformation.
